scenes.text: Myth or fact? Oily skin doesn't need moisturiser.
Skip moisturiser, and your skin gets dehydrated. Dehydrated skin can actually make more oil.
scenes.head: Dehydrated skin can make more oil.
scenes.body: Skipping moisturiser often makes shine worse, not better.

scenes.text: So use a light gel moisturiser, every day.
scenes.rule: Oily skin? Use a light gel moisturiser.

scenes.text: Send this to your friend with oily skin. Follow for more.
scenes.cta: Send this to your oily-skin friend.

caption:
Oily skin doesn't need moisturiser? Myth. 💧
Skipping it can dehydrate your skin, and dehydrated skin can make even more oil. A light gel moisturiser fixes it.
Send this to your oily-skin friend. Follow for Myth or Fact every week.
